What the Steady Income model would have done, for the periods ending December 31, 2025: 1 year 8.9% gross, 7.8% net; 5 years 7.1% gross, 6.0% net; 10 years 7.6% gross, 6.5% net (5- and 10-year figures are average annual returns). These are hypothetical, backtested results, not the returns of any client account: the model holds a fixed 60/40 mix of two broad index funds, rebalanced each January, with net figures deducting the 1.00% annual advisory fee and trading costs. Hypothetical results have inherent limitations, do not reflect actual trading, and cannot account for the effect of market conditions on decision-making; the model could have lost money in any period. Full model trade records are available on request. This page is open to every visitor, no login required.
